description_en: Retrieves all outbound phone numbers of an agent, including personal outbound numbers and outbound numbers of the skill groups to which the agent belongs
description_zh: 调用ListOutboundPhoneNumberOfUser获取坐席的所有外呼电话列表，包含个人外呼号码及所属技能组外呼号码
name: ListOutboundPhoneNumberOfUser

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the Cloud Call Center
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the user whose outbound phone number list you want to retrieve.

This is the unique identifier (UUID) of the RAM user in the Cloud Call Center instance, not the RAM ID
parameters.help_zh:
待获取外呼号码列表的用户ID。

这里是RAM子账号在呼叫中心实例的唯一标识并非RamId，即UUID
parameters.name: user_id

items.description_en: The list of actual outbound phone numbers

PhoneNumber.description_en: The phone numbers that the agent can use to make outbound calls
PhoneNumber.description_zh: 获取到的坐席拨打外线时电话号码

AllowOutbound.description_en:
Indicates whether outbound calls are allowed. The result depends on:

The carrier settings. For example, 400 numbers do not allow outbound calls.
The Cloud Call Center instance settings.

Phone numbers generally allow inbound calls. If inbound calls are not allowed, you can: 1) Configure the carrier settings so that callers hear a prompt tone when dialing the number. 2) Unbind the contact flow IVR from the number. However, this approach is not recommended
AllowOutbound.description_zh:
是否允许外呼，结果取决于：

大于的设置，比如400号码不允许外呼
呼叫中心实例的设置

电话号码一般都允许内呼，如果不允许内呼，可以1）由大于做设置，用户拨打该号码时听到提示音 2）该号码不绑定联系流IVR，但是ACC不建议这么做

City.description_en: The city to which the number belongs

InstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the Cloud Call Center to which the phone number belongs
InstanceId.description_zh: 电话号码所归属的呼叫中心实例ID

PhoneNumberDescription.description_en: The description of the phone number

PhoneNumberId.description_en: The phone number ID, which is a unique identifier automatically generated by the system
PhoneNumberId.description_zh: 电话号码ID，系统自动生成的唯一标示符

PrivacyNumber.description_en: The privacy number binding associated with the phone number
PrivacyNumber.description_zh: 电话号码所绑定的虚拟号码关系

Extra.description_en: The additional parameters, stored as a JSON string
Extra.description_zh: 其他参数，以Json字符串存入

PhoneNumber.description_en: The bound Cloud Call Center number

PoolId.description_en: The ID of the privacy number pool

PoolName.description_en: The name of the privacy number pool

RegionNameCity.description_en: The city to which the privacy number belongs

SubId.description_en: The unique identifier of the binding. This field is returned when the type is AXN. If the type is AXB, this field is empty
SubId.description_zh: 类型为AXN，返回的绑定关系唯一标识，若类型为AXB，则此字段为空

TelX.description_en: The virtual number bound in AXN mode. If the type is AXB, this field is empty
TelX.description_zh: 选择AXN模式绑定的虚拟号码，若类型为AXB，则此字段为空

Type.description_en: The type of privacy number binding. Valid values: AXN and AXB
Type.description_zh: 选择绑定虚拟号码的类型，包括AXN和AXB

PrivateFlag.description_en: Indicates whether the number is a personal outbound number
PrivateFlag.description_zh: 标识该号码是否为个人外呼号码

Province.description_en: The province to which the number belongs

RemainingTime.description_en: The remaining call time of the test number. Unit: minutes
RemainingTime.description_zh: 测试号码剩余的通话时间。单位为分钟

TestOnly.description_en: Indicates whether the number is a test number

Trunks.description_en: The number of trunks for the phone number, which indicates the number of concurrent calls supported. The data is provided by the carrier
Trunks.description_zh: 电话号码的中继数量，即可同时支持几路通话，数据来源于大于

Usage.description_en:
The usage of the phone number: inbound (Inbound), outbound (Outbound), or both inbound and outbound (Bidirection). These values are defined by the PhoneNumberType enumeration.

The result depends on:

The carrier settings. For example, 400 numbers do not allow outbound calls.
The Cloud Call Center instance settings.

Phone numbers generally allow inbound calls. If inbound calls are not allowed, you can: 1) Configure the carrier settings so that callers hear a prompt tone when dialing the number. 2) Disconnect the number from the contact flow IVR. However, this approach is not recommended
Usage.description_zh:
电话号码的用途，呼入（Inbound），呼出（Outbound），已经同时用于呼入和呼出（Bidirection）。上述值由枚举类型PhoneNumberType定义。

该值的结果取决于：

大于的设置，比如400号码不允许外呼
呼叫中心实例的设置


电话号码一般都允许内呼，如果不允许内呼，可以1）由大于做设置，用户拨打该号码时听到提示音 2）该号码不连接人和联系流IVR，但是ACC不建议这么做

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
